# List Item

**Figma:** List-Item (4080:11700) + .Primitives/List-Item/Mobile/* (page 4080:4632)  
**Import:** `import { List, ListItem } from "@zen/design-system";`

One row of a vertical list: a leading visual, a title with an optional caption, and a trailing slot for actions or a passive chevron / value.

## Use it for
- People, messages, files and settings lists.
- Navigation lists that drill down (href / onClick with a passive chevron).
- Rows with one or two quick actions (message, add, more) next to the row's own click target.

## Use something else for
- Comparable data across several columns → Table.
- Choices users toggle in a form → Checkbox / RadioButton / Toggle groups.
- Menu options in a popover → Popover items.
- Horizontal card grids → Card.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Leading | `leading` | Avatar (Image-Size/Medium, 40px), Dock Icon, thumbnail — Figma Leading on/off |
| Contents | `title · caption · children` | Title Body/Base/Bold (one line, truncates) + caption Body/Small/Regular Light (may wrap); children replace the stack |
| Trailing | `trailing` | Figma Slot-Actions: Button/Icon-Flat Medium (IconButton appearance="flat" size="md", 40px), gap Small; or a passive chevron, value or Badge |
| State | `selected · onClick · href` | Default / Hover / Pressed from real interaction; Selected = Active/Neutral/Subtle — the Interactive-Background is inset 12px, Corner-Radius/Large |
| List | `<List aria-label inset>` | ul wrapper. inset = auto (default) · comfortable (Margin/Comfortable 24px) · compact (Margin/Compact) · none (0). auto follows the layout: 24px full-bleed on a page, 0 inside Modal, Side Panel, Card and a Stack or Box with padding, which already pad their content |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/list-item.json`.

### List
A plain list of List-Items (ul, no bullets).

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLUListElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLUListElement>` | — | The root `<ul>`. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `inset` | `"auto" \| "comfortable" \| "compact" \| "none"` | `"auto"` | Horizontal inset of the rows' content, following the layout it sits in. auto (default): full-bleed on a page = Margin/Comfortable (24px); inside a container that already has its own padding (Modal, Side Panel, Card) = none, so row content lines up with the container's other content. comfortable = Margin/Comfortable, compact = Margin/Compact, none = 0 (the hover/selected fill bleeds 12px outward). |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### ListItem
Figma List-Item (4080:11700): padding Spacing/Padding/Small × Margin-Comfortable, a Wrapper row (gap Medium) of Leading · Contents · Trailing, and an Interactive-Background inset 12px (Corner-Radius/Large) that shows Neutral/Flat Hover · Pressed and Active/Neutral/Subtle when selected.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "title" | "onClick">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` | — | The root row element. |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Info-Content Title (Body/Base/Bold, Content/Neutral/Strongest). |
| `caption` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Info-Content Subtitle (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Light). |
| `leading` | `IconName \| ReactNode` | — | Figma Leading slot: an Avatar (Image-Size/Medium), Dock Icon, thumbnail or an icon name (`"icon-clock-line"`). |
| `trailing` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Trailing slot (Slot-Actions): Medium (md) buttons / icon buttons, a Badge, a value or a chevron. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Contents slot override: replaces the title/caption stack. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Figma State=Selected (Background/Active/Neutral/Subtle). |
| `onClick` | `(event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement \| HTMLAnchorElement>) => void` | — | Makes the row one action (Hover / Pressed from real interaction). Keep trailing buttons out of clickable rows. |
| `href` | `string` | — | Renders the row as a link. |
| `as` | `"li" \| "div"` | `"li"` | "li" (default, inside `<List>`) or "div" when used on its own. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between rows and trailing actions |
| Enter / Space | Activate a clickable row |

## ✅ Do
- Wrap rows in <List aria-label> so the group is named.
- Make the whole row the target (onClick / href) when it opens one thing; for drill-down add a passive chevron.
- Put quick actions in the trailing slot as Button/Icon-Flat Medium (IconButton appearance="flat" size="md") with an aria-label. They work on clickable rows too — Figma keeps the trailing action in Hover, Pressed and Selected — and stay separate targets that don't open the row.
- Keep to one or two trailing actions; move the rest into a More (…) menu.
- Let the title truncate on one line; keep the caption short (it may wrap to a second line).
- Mark the current row with selected (Active/Neutral/Subtle), not a custom fill.
- Let the row inset follow the layout: full-bleed lists on a page keep 24px, lists inside a Modal, Side Panel or Card line up with the container's content (inset auto → none) and the hover fill bleeds into its padding. Set inset only when the layout needs something else.
- Split long settings into groups: a visible heading per group and one List per group named after it (aria-label or aria-labelledby).
- In a bordered Card, derive the container from the row's hover fill (Corner-Radius/Large): card padding Padding/2XSmall (4) top and bottom, row inset Padding/Small + Padding/2XSmall (16), card radius Corner-Radius/XLarge (= Large + 4). The fill then sits 4 from every edge with concentric corners in every radius mode.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't make only the chevron or a trailing button the way to open the row — the whole row is the target.
- Don't put a Toggle or Checkbox on a clickable row: the row click and the switch compete. Make the row flip the switch, or keep the row static (harness: list-item/clickable-row-toggle).
- Don't use Small or text buttons in the trailing slot; trailing actions are Medium icon buttons (harness: list-item/trailing-button-medium).
- Don't mix leading sizes in one list — row heights stop lining up.
- Don't override .zen-list-item padding for spacing — use <List inset> or --zen-list-inset on the container (harness: list-item/inset-not-padding).
- Don't use a list for data users compare across columns.
- Don't hand-build rows (a div with a Text and a Badge or Button); use ListItem so padding, hit area and focus are consistent.

## Accessibility
- A clickable row is one `<button>`/`<a>` covering the row with a visible focus ring; selected rows expose aria-pressed / aria-current.
- Trailing actions are separate buttons after the row in the tab order, each named by aria-label; activating them never triggers the row.

## Content
- Title = the object's name; caption = the most useful fact (role, last message, size).

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list-item/inset-not-padding` | warn | List rows take their horizontal inset from the layout (List inset / --zen-list-inset), never a padding override on .zen-list-item — a fixed padding double-indents rows inside Modals, Side Panels and Cards. | `zen-allow-list-inset: <reason>` |
| `list-item/clickable-row-toggle` | warn | A clickable row (onClick/href) doesn't also carry a Toggle or Checkbox — the row click and the switch compete. Trailing icon buttons are fine (Figma Slot-Actions). | `zen-allow-row-toggle: <reason>` |
| `list-item/trailing-button-medium` | warn | Buttons in a List-Item trailing slot are size Medium (md). | `zen-allow-trailing-size: <reason>` |
| `copy/plural-count` | warn | Counts agree with their noun (1 item · 2 items): build the phrase with a plural helper, never `{list.length} items`. | `zen-allow-plural: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
